_comment: Live data endpoints the sync engine tries, in order. Edit freely - endpoints for unofficial APIs change. {origin} {dest} {date} placeholders are substituted. If everything fails, the agent falls back to seed data + deep links.

attempts.name: flyfrontier-flight-search-page
attempts.notes: The sync engine now parses this page's embedded journeys JSON for per-flight GoWild fields (isGoWildFareEnabled, goWildFare, goWildFareSeatsRemaining) - visible without login. Bot protection may 403; the agent paces requests 2-4s and stops at the first block. See docs/API-OPTIONS.md.

communityTrackers.name: GoWilder
communityTrackers.notes: Hosted GoWild availability search - fastest way to see which flights show GoWild seats

communityTrackers.name: WildFares
communityTrackers.notes: GoWild companion with maps, multi-hop routing, real-time availability

frontier.officialApi: developer.flyfrontier.com is NDC for accredited travel-trade partners only - no hobbyist access

amtraker.notes: Free, no key. Live positions/status of all Amtrak trains (no fares).

apify._comment: Optional live award source via the Apify flight-award-scraper actor. Set APIFY_TOKEN in .env to enable. The actor runs per origin/destination pair (bounded by maxRuns) and returns award rows as JSON. VERIFY inputTemplate field names against the actor's input schema at https://apify.com/igolaizola/flight-award-scraper - edit here if they differ; the output parser already tolerates common field-name variants. Note: the actor only supports departures within ~60 days, and each run consumes Apify usage credits.

flixbus._comment: FlixBus's own search API needs no key and covers Greyhound too (Greyhound moved onto FlixBus's booking platform in 2023). cityNames map our place codes to what FlixBus's autocomplete expects; resolved UUIDs get cached into the snapshot on sync. Paste known UUIDs into cityIds to skip the lookup.

hotels._comment: Live public hotel rates via SerpAPI google_hotels (needs SERPAPI_KEY). Broad per-city queries keep the search count low (~3/sync); property names are matched to hotels.json. Member/express rates are captured via the booking links in hotels.json, not here.

deepLinks._amtrakNote: Historical prefill pattern - Amtrak SPA deep links are not officially documented; if params stop prefilling, the page still opens the booking search.

priceline._comment: Priceline Express Deals via the RapidAPI priceline-com-provider listing (a passthrough to Priceline Partner Network's getExpress.Results). Set RAPIDAPI_KEY to enable. READ-ONLY: the listing exposes no Express.Book, so booking still happens on priceline.com. Express availability depends on the reseller's upstream PPN tier and can change without notice.
